thread:
Sam (AE): quick sync — Helix EU wants to convert the POC to a PO. They gave a PO from their German holding but want the UK trading entity to sign. Also they redlined the DPA asking for HSM attestation and made it a condition of payment. Need legal/finance/security advice on POA, VAT, and attestation path.

Priya (Legal): paste the redline text here and procurement contact. If signer != billing entity we need a notarized POA or eIDAS. We should not accept attestation as a condition precedent to payment.

Sam (AE): redline snippet: "Provider must deliver HSM attestation within 10 business days of execution. Failure to provide attestation permits Customer to withhold payment." Procurement contact: procurement@helix.eu.

Diego (Security): we can provide HSM attestation but only for Dedicated/Private with BYO-HSM or partner HSM. Hosted tier does not include attestation. 10 business days is unrealistic — ops needs 30–60 days and likely an SOW.

Rina (FinOps): billing notes — if the German holding issues the PO but the UK entity signs, we need a payer mapping annex. VAT depends on invoiced entity; ask for VAT reg. PO number required to bind. Net30 standard.

Priya (Legal): propose counters: remove payment-withhold clause and replace with "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide a scoped HSM attestation for Dedicated/Private deployments; timeline and fees to be set in a SOW; Hosted tier excluded." Add annex listing acceptable POA: notarized POA, eIDAS advanced certificate, or corporate board resolution plus government ID. Add 14-day cure for missing POA.

Diego (Security): add a line: "Attestation delivery is subject to product-ops scheduling; customer will cooperate in required evidence sharing."

Rina (FinOps): finance OK with that approach. We need PO#, billing legal name, VAT number, and payer mapping to proceed with invoicing. If they insist on payment on attestation, escalate to RevOps.

Sam (AE): I'll push the counters and ask procurement for PO#, VAT reg, payer mapping, and a scanned POA (notarized or eIDAS). I'll also ask whether they can accept an SOW and 30–45 day attestation window.

esig-bot: Envelope created (env_hlx_001) for Order Form + Addendum — awaiting signatures.

Priya (Legal): thanks. Once we have POA and payer mapping I'll finalize the addendum and the POA annex.

Sam (AE): will update thread when procurement replies. :thumbsup:
